issues.evidence: repair_quote.pdf (/home/cominty/user_uploads/ol-lPElx/repair_quote.pdf) shows 'TOTAL INCL. VAT 1 640,00 €'; the €900 in the customer email is only the garage's verbal phone estimate ('around €900'), and contract Article 1 defines repair cost as the total including VAT on the written quote (document 2630#10414, page 1).

issues.should_be: yes — independent assessor must inspect the vehicle when the repair cost is above €1,500, and the quote's total incl. VAT is €1,640.00
issues.evidence: Contract Article 6.1 (document 2630#10414, page 3) vs. repair_quote.pdf total incl. VAT of €1,640.00.

verdict.summary: The claim is payable in principle (C2 collision is in the Policy Schedule, reported within 5 days, no exclusion, no third party so no accident report needed, photos and quote provided), but the recorded repair cost is the verbal €900 estimate instead of the €1,640.00 total incl. VAT on the attached quote, which also means an independent assessor is required above €1,500 — the staged payout of €600 is therefore based on a wrong fact.
